title: Breathing Under Water: Spirituality and the Twelve Steps
author: Richard Rohr
rights_note: In copyright and in print, all rights reserved. Never stored here. The copy consulted was an unauthorized posting; see metadata.json.
provenance_problem: The file consulted carries an OceanofPDF.com imprint on every chapter break. That is an unauthorized distribution site, and the work is a current in-print commercial title, so the posting was plainly not authorized by the rights holder. This is a stronger objection than the unverified-authorization cases of DeGroot 1974 and the 1946 Grapevine. The project's response: the file is not retained, not committed, and not quoted at length; the bibliographic record was confirmed independently against publisher and library listings rather than taken from the file; and every claim drawn from it is an unquantified statement about how the book reads its subject, which is the weakest use the four-layer rule allows.

editions.copy_consulted: London: SPCK, 2016. ISBN 9780281075126. Copyright Richard Rohr 2011, 2016.

what_it_cannot_support: Nothing about what AA groups do. It is one author's theological reading of the Steps, contains no fieldwork, and does not discuss the Traditions at all.
documents_note: Documents are git-ignored. Re-acquire from the recorded URL and check the SHA-256 above.
provenance_resolved: 17 August 2026. The Human Author holds a lawfully obtained copy. The objection concerned the project's access resting on an unauthorized posting, not the accuracy of the reading. No claim drawn from this work carries a page citation, so the edition difference between the 2011 first edition cited and the 2016 printing consulted is immaterial.
